newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Jamaica bauxite exports up, earnings down.
newsitem.headline: Jamaica bauxite exports up, earnings down.

text.p: Jamaica's total bauxite shipments reached their highest levels since 1981 but gross earnings by the sector declined marginally, the government-run Jamaica Bauxite Institute announced Tuesday.
The JBI said total bauxite exports stood at 11.79 metric tonnes, up 8.6 percent over the 10.86 tonnes recorded last year.

Total alumina exports reached 3.2 million metric tonnes, an increase of 5.4 percent over the 3.03 million tonnes shipped last year, while crude bauxite exports rose 10.5 percent, from 3.53 million metric tonnes to 3.9 million tonnes this year.
The institute said technical difficulties at the Alpart and Jamalco alumina refineries this year resulted in a 150,000 metric tonne shortfall in alumina production.
Gross earnings for the sector have been put at $695.5 million this year, down just over 2 percent from last year's $710.7 million.
The JBI blamed low prices due to poor demand and oversupply of aluminium caused by Russian exports for the downward trend in earnings.
